name: MaxX Single Property Schema For Houzez Theme Only
author: Muhammad Irfan Ghori

sections.description:
MaxX Houzez Schema is a specialized WordPress plugin designed exclusively for the Houzez theme that automatically generates comprehensive Schema.org markup for your property listings. This plugin helps search engines better understand your real estate content, potentially leading to enhanced visibility in search results with rich snippets.

Key Features:

  • Property Schema Generation: Automatically creates detailed Schema.org markup for single property pages
  • Multiple Schema Types: Choose from various schema types including SingleFamilyResidence, Apartment, House, and more
  • Currency Support: Select from 10+ international currencies for property pricing
  • Gallery Image Support: Includes all property gallery images in the schema markup
  • Aggregate Ratings: Add rating information to improve click-through rates
  • Random Rating Generator: Option to generate unique random ratings for each property
  • Breadcrumb Schema: Enhance navigation with structured breadcrumb data
  • Modern Admin Interface: Clean, intuitive settings panel with live schema preview
  • Real-time Preview: See exactly how your schema will appear as you make changes
  • Houzez Integration: Seamlessly works with all Houzez property fields and data
  • One-Click Testing: Direct links to Google Rich Results Test and Schema.org Validator

Schema Types Supported:
* SingleFamilyResidence
* Apartment
* House
* Residence
* RealEstateListing
* Accommodation

Benefits:
* Improved SEO performance
* Enhanced search engine visibility
* Rich snippets in Google search results
* Better structured data for voice search
* Increased click-through rates
* Compliance with Google’s structured data guidelines

This plugin is specifically designed for the Houzez theme and requires Houzez to be installed and activated.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Donate

If you enjoy using this plugin, please consider donating to support further development.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/maxx-single-property-schema directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘MaxX Houzez Schema’ under the Settings menu to configure options.
sections.faq:
Do I need the Houzez theme for this plugin to work?

Yes, this plugin is designed specifically for the Houzez theme and requires it to be installed and activated.

Will this improve my SEO?

Yes, by adding structured data to your property listings, search engines can better understand your content, which can lead to improved visibility in search results.

Can I customize the schema for my properties?

Absolutely! The plugin provides a comprehensive settings panel where you can customize schema types, currencies, ratings, and more.
